executiveSummary: The Authority remains operationally ready for the 2026 hurricane season, with no identified threats to overall system integrity. Q3 field inspections are approximately 95% complete, and all PCCP stations and complex structures remain operational and mission ready. Project execution remains a major leadership focus, with construction and repair activities continuing across several priority projects, while efforts to strengthen project planning and delivery through FPA PACE, long-term financial modeling, and cultural transformation are also advancing.
maintenanceActivities: Routine levee, floodwall, floodgate, valve, facility, and equipment maintenance continued with no impacts to system readiness.
Annual floodgate inspections remain up to date; Q3 valve inspections and exercises are complete as of August 26, 2026.
Field safety checks, required training, facility preparation, and seasonal readiness activities continue during hurricane season.
Facility repairs, warehouse system maintenance, and support infrastructure improvements remain ongoing.
Levee turf maintenance is slightly behind due to recent rain but catching up as weather conditions improve; no readiness impacts reported.
Interim sand/HESCO basket protection along the crown of the levee at LPV-111 slide locations installed by Maintenance Department.
